row.title: Conflict markers on main plus per-deploy claim rewrites keep every README PR in conflict
row.body: Markers merged by #834 sat inside the README status table; every deploy record rewrites the live-deploys claim on that line (several times an hour), so any PR touching README.md conflicted within minutes and the claim-only resolver could not help because the conflicting region also held marker lines. Removed the markers; tests pass on this branch. The tick sweeper also ran out of its subrequest share on most passes (sweeper_runs 682-684), so the webhook route in seed/worker/src/mergenow.js is the primary merge path and the sweeper is the fallback.
